sources.title: Model Reference — Cosmos - NVIDIA Documentation Hub
sources.snippet: Model Reference # Cosmos 3 is available as Cosmos3-Super (64B), Cosmos3-Nano (16B), and Cosmos3-Edge (4B). The model family also includes task-specific variants: Cosmos3-Super-Text2Image, Cosmos3-Super-Image2Video, their four-step Text2Image and Image2Video variants, plus Cosmos3-Nano-Policy-DROID and Cosmos3-Edge-Policy-DROID.
